regime_dna.reason: The verified source establishes Turtle breakout, exit, risk, sizing and execution rules, but no explicit formal market-regime classification rule is documented in the captured source evidence. Inference is prohibited.

failure_condition_dna.evidence: A System 1 breakout is treated as a losing breakout when, after the breakout date, price moves 2N against the position before a profitable 10-day exit occurs. A losing previous breakout permits the subsequent System 1 breakout to be taken regardless of direction.
failure_condition_dna.reference: The Original Turtle Trading Rules, Chapter Entries, System 1 Entry / Breakouts, pp. 19-20
